lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm2CdSe4 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 14 atoms—2 Tm, 2 Cd, and 10 Se—distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd in octahedral coordination by 6 Se neighbors, while Tm adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor Se environment. The neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cd octahedra and between Cd octahedra and Tm 12-vertex polyhedra, plus face-sharing between Cd octahedra and Tm polyhedra.
